articles.title: Proposed CLARITY ethics deal could save Trump millions in taxes: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The latest bipartisan ethics proposal would reportedly require Trump to divest crypto businesses while allowing him to defer capital gains taxes on those sales.

articles.title: Tokyo Tells Trump to Stop Meme-ing Mario
articles.snippet: Tokyo has asked Washington to stop meme-posting Mario, Pokémon, and Naruto without permission in a clash between meme-heavy statecraft and strict IP norms.
